query: ESG指标与薪酬挂钩 ESG指标与薪酬挂钩 衡量ESG绩效在高管薪酬中的绑定程度。 0分 无机制/未披露 违反港交所强制披露规定。具体指：未在年报“董事会报告”或“企业管治报告”中明确回应薪酬与ESG的关联审查。 1分 定性绑定 / 模糊权重 仅限于披露了“ESG指标作为薪酬考量因素之一”，但仅局限于定性调整项（Modifier） 或仅挂钩非实质性指标（如：按时发布ESG报告、获得ESG奖项）。 2分 量化权重 满足以下两个条件中的一个即可： 1. 量化目标：必须披露具体的KPI数值（如：范围1+2碳排放下降X%）。 2. 权重透明：明确写明年终花红（Bonus）中ESG权重≥X%。 ESG薪酬挂钩 可持续发展激励 花红权重 ESG考核指标 短期激励 长期激励 薪酬委员会 定性调节项 STIP LTIP KPI ESG-linked remuneration sustainability-linked incentives bonus weight ESG KPI STIP LTIP pay for performance remuneration committee modifier KPI 高管薪酬是否与ESG绩效挂钩？ 是否披露具体量化KPI（如排放下降X%）？ 年终花红中ESG权重是否明确？ 若仅为定性modifier或非实质性指标，具体是什么？ 薪酬委员会如何审议该安排？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator 'ESG指标与薪酬挂钩'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 高管薪酬是否与ESG绩效挂钩？ 是否披露具体量化KPI（如排放下降X%）？ 年终花红中ESG权重是否明确？ 若仅为定性modifier或非实质性指标，具体是什么？ 薪酬委员会如何审议该安排？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有董事会ESG监督、企业减排目标或员工股权激励，但未明确进入高管薪酬；仅有一般薪酬委员会职责而无ESG关联。不要排除按时发布ESG报告、获得ESG奖项等非实质性KPI：若明确挂钩高管薪酬，应作为1分弱绑定证据。区分：定性modifier或非实质性KPI支持1分；具体ESG KPI数值或明确奖金权重支持2分。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Section]
SUSTAINABILITY IN OUR SUPPLY CHAINS

[Content]
As we continue to roll out new initiatives to reduce the environmental footprint of our products, we recognise that engaging with our suppliers is crucial to meeting our goals. Since FY2020, we have issued formal letters with our Green Product and Process requirements to all our suppliers and requested a yearly report from them on their environmental performance, including their carbon footprint. On an ongoing basis, we also consult with key suppliers and welcome their ideas on how our products and processes can be made more sustainable.

results.text: Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. We currently also have a strong business continuity plan for our supply chains, described on page 19 of this report, under 'Supply chains and Business continuity'.

Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. We currently also have a strong business continuity plan for our supply chains, described on page 19 of this report, under 'Supply chains and Business continuity'.
